one_liner: Reconciles an admitted patient's pre-admission medicines across four siloed systems (hospital EMR, GP, pharmacy, patient interview) via Zetaris, treats a missing source as unknown, ranks high-risk discrepancies first, and learns from pharmacist feedback which source to trust. Synthetic data only.

zetaris.role: data layer; agents get every fact by sending Lightning SQL to the Zetaris REST API
zetaris.integration: app/adapters/zetaris.py (read-only REST adapter, per-run budget of 8, SAMPLE_MODE replay); app/domain/packs/medtrace/queries.py (SQL templates); scripts/register_sources.py (registration)
zetaris.status: working: four silos and reference tables registered as REST tables with a harmonised view, verified live on two machines; every agent fact comes back through the adapter

meterless.provider: Meterless Nightshift Runtime, OpenAI-compatible, primary AI provider for every model call
meterless.integration: app/adapters/meterless.py (Nightshift provider for every model call); app/engines/world_model/ and app/engines/hmem/ (engine ports); app/agents/identity_memory.py, app/agents/memory.py (engines in the product)
meterless.status: working: Nightshift is the provider for every model call (Planner, Executor, Writer, Evaluator), verified live; World Model 8/8 and H-MEM 13/13 official conformance checks green (make conformance); World Model carries identity state and remembered pharmacist decisions, H-MEM holds the trust the pharmacist teaches and the Planner's recalled memories
